webEndpoint.tunnelUnreachableFromBrowser: This endpoint tunnels to 127.0.0.1 on the machine running Termix, which your browser cannot reach. Set the endpoint's Bind Host to an address that machine answers on, such as 0.0.0.0, and give it a fixed Local Port.
webEndpoint.tunnelSharesSessionCookie: Opening this tunnel would send your Termix session to the tunnelled service, because your browser would reach it at the same hostname Termix is served from. Cookies ignore the port, so the two cannot be told apart. Use the Termix desktop app, or open Termix at localhost.
webEndpoint.directSharesSessionCookie: Opening this endpoint would send your Termix session to it, because your browser reaches it at the same site Termix is served from. Cookies ignore the port, so a different port is not a different identity. Use the Termix desktop app, or serve this web UI from a different hostname.
webEndpoint.isolationUnavailable: This browser cannot isolate web endpoints from your Termix session. Use a browser with credentialless iframe support.
webEndpoint.isolationNotice: Embedded pages use an isolated session. For pages requiring storage or popup sign-in, use an isolated window in the desktop app.

hosts.webUiRequirementsText: A direct endpoint is opened by your browser, so its port must be reachable from here. An SSH tunnel is opened by Termix over this host's SSH connection instead, so the port only has to be reachable from the host.
hosts.enableWebUiDesc: Open this host's web interfaces from the sidebar.
hosts.webUiBindHostDesc: Where the backend binds the forward. Leave blank for 127.0.0.1, which only the machine running Termix can reach.
hosts.webUiBindHostExposed: This address is reachable beyond the Termix machine, so anyone who can reach the port gets this web UI with no login.
hosts.webUiLocalPortDesc: Which port the forward listens on. Leave blank to let the system pick, or set one when the port has to be known in advance, such as a container that publishes it.
hosts.webUiAccessTunnelUnavailable: An SSH tunnel needs SSH enabled on this host and a connection origin of this device.
hosts.webUiRenderEmbeddedDesc: Embedding is best effort: some web interfaces refuse to load in a frame, and a login that relies on same-site cookies may loop. The external browser always works.
hosts.webUiIgnoreCertDesc: Direct endpoints only. Loopback is already exempt, so this has no effect on tunnel endpoints.
hosts.webUiOpenFailed: Failed to open the web endpoint
